description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange Effective from 12.10.2020 to 18.10.2020
reasoning: This gazette notification announces new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges, which constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement under the Customs Ordinance.
